10,383 | owntitle = Owner | owner = [[Yevhen Krasnikov]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Andriy Anishchenko]] | league = [[Ukrainian First League]] | season = [[2025–26 Ukrainian First League|2025–26]] | position = Ukrainian First League, 7th of 16 | website = {{URL|https://fcmetalist.com.ua/}} | pattern_la1 = _jomatoletum4yb | pattern_b1 = _jomatoletum4yb | pattern_ra1 = _jomatoletum4yb | pattern_sh1 = _ | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFF00 | body1 = FFFF00 | rightarm1 = FFFF00 | shorts1 = FFFF00 | socks1 = FFFF00 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _metalist2122a | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000040 | body2 = 000040 | rightarm2 = 000040 | socks2 = 000040 | shorts2 = 000040 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = _metalist2122t | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = FFFFFF | body3 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = FFFFFF | socks3 = FFFFFF | shorts3 = FFFFFF | current = }} '''Football Club Metalist Kharkiv''', also known as '''Football Club Metalist Kharkov''' or '''FC Metalist Kharkov''' ({{langx|uk|Футбо́льний Клуб Металі́ст Ха́рків}} {{IPA|uk|metɐˈl⁽ʲ⁾ist ˈxɑrkiu̯|}}), is a Ukrainian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Kharkiv]] that plays in the [[Ukrainian First League]] during the [[2023–24 Ukrainian First League|2023–24 season]]. It was revived five years after the original FC Metalist Kharkiv ceased operations. Founded in 1925, FC Metalist Kharkiv had worked its way up the rungs of the [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] football system, eventually being promoted to the [[Soviet Top League]] in 1960. After a difficult period which included relegation, Metalist was promoted to the Top League again in 1982, where it remained until the league's dissolution. The club won the [[Soviet Cup]] once, and were also runners-up once. Following the dissolution of the Soviet Union, they have also won silver medals in the [[2012–13 Ukrainian Premier League]] and six bronze medals in the [[Ukrainian Premier League]], starting from the [[2006–07 Ukrainian Premier League|2006–07 season]]. Their home was the [[Metalist Stadium]], a multi-use facility with a capacity of 40,003. The [[stadium]] was originally built in 1926 and was expanded to host [[Euro 2012]] football matches. Metalist ceased operations in [[2015–16 Ukrainian Premier League|2016]] due to [[insolvency]]. Metalist owed in salary to its players €32 million with €5 million to [[Cleiton Xavier]] in particular.[https://champion.com.ua/football/2021/09/23/882730/metalist-zaborguvav-gravtsyam-32-mln-yevro Металіст заборгував гравцям 32 млн євро] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926165324/https://champion.com.ua/football/2021/09/23/882730/metalist-zaborguvav-gravtsyam-32-mln-yevro |date=26 September 2021 }}. champion.com.ua. 23 September 2021 It was removed from the Ukrainian Premier League after owner [[Serhiy Kurchenko]] absconded in February 2014, following the [[2014 Ukrainian revolution]]. Following the demise of Metalist Kharkiv in 2016, two new clubs were created in Kharkiv with variations of the Metalist club name. Since July 2016, a team named "SK Metalist Kharkiv" has been playing in the [[Regional championships of Ukraine (football)|Kharkiv Oblast Championship]], whose owner is Metalist owner Serhiy Kurchenko.{{cite web|url=http://ua.tribuna.com/tribuna/blogs/butilka/1023896.html|title=СК "Металлист" vs "Металлист 1925": что это за клубы и чем они отличаются|date=20 August 2016|access-date=4 December 2017|archive-date=10 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171110114656/https://ua.tribuna.com/tribuna/blogs/butilka/1023896.html|url-status=dead}} In August 2016, another club named "[[FC Metalist 1925 Kharkiv]]" began to operate in the [[Ukrainian Amateur Football League]] with the stated intention of competing in the (professional) [[Ukrainian Second League]] as soon as possible.{{in lang|ru}} [http://www.sq.com.ua/rus/news/novosti/25.08.2016/v_harkove_prezentovali_futbolnuyu_komandu_metallist_1925/ In Kharkov, presented the team "Metalist 1925"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612141938/http://www.sq.com.ua/rus/news/novosti/25.08.2016/v_harkove_prezentovali_futbolnuyu_komandu_metallist_1925/ |date=12 June 2018 }}, SQ (25 August 2016) "FC Metalist 1925 Kharkiv" is owned by a company not linked with the original FC Metalist Kharkiv. In October 2017, a Ukrainian court confiscated (the original) Metalist Kharkiv from Kurchenko and placed it under [[state property]]. At the time the club did not participate in any official sanctioned competitions.{{in lang|uk}} [http://m.tyzhden.ua/News/201170 The court returned the Metalist FC to the state property] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180501152143/http://m.tyzhden.ua/News/201170 |date=1 May 2018 }}, [[The Ukrainian Week]] (3 October 2017) Also in July 2020, former FC Metalist sports director Yevhen Krasnikov created [[FC Metal Kharkiv]] which has since participated in the Ukrainian Second League. Earlier on 5 May 2020, [[Oleksandr Yaroslavskyi]] announced that he wishes to take care of the debts of the liquidated Metalist.[https://sport.ua/uk/news/486756-tsyganyk-rasskazal-kakim-obrazom-yaroslavskiy-hochet-vernut-metallist Циганик розповів, яким чином Ярославський хоче повернути Металіст] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926171124/https://sport.ua/uk/news/486756-tsyganyk-rasskazal-kakim-obrazom-yaroslavskiy-hochet-vernut-metallist |date=26 September 2021 }}. sport.ua. 5 May 2020[https://footballhub.com.ua/spravzhnij-metalist-shho-vzhe-zaraz-robyt-yaroslavskyj-shhob-povernuty-klub-sobi/ Справжній Металіст. Що вже зараз робить Ярославський, щоб повернути клуб собі?] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926171123/https://footballhub.com.ua/spravzhnij-metalist-shho-vzhe-zaraz-robyt-yaroslavskyj-shhob-povernuty-klub-sobi/ |date=26 September 2021 }}. footballhub.com.ua. 4 May 2020[https://lb.ua/sport/2020/05/05/456811_yaroslavskiy_sobiraetsya_vikupit.html Ярославський планує викупити борги "Металіста" і воскресити клуб ] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926171122/https://lb.ua/sport/2020/05/05/456811_yaroslavskiy_sobiraetsya_vikupit.html |date=26 September 2021 }}. lb.ua. 5 May 2020Yevhenia Motorevska. ''[https://www.slidstvo.info/articles/antykryzovyk-yaroslavskyj-shho-vidomo-pro-harkivskogo-biznesmena/ Антикризовик Ярославський: що відомо про харківського бізнесмена] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926171844/https://www.slidstvo.info/articles/antykryzovyk-yaroslavskyj-shho-vidomo-pro-harkivskogo-biznesmena/ |date=26 September 2021 }}. www.slidstvo.info. 23 March 2020'' The return of Yaroslavskyi to football arose some criticism connected with politics of the city of Kharkiv.[https://24tv.ua/deoligarhizatsiya-navpaki-yak-harkiv-hochut-peretvoriti-novini-harkova_n1649205 Деолігархізація навпаки: як Харків хочуть перетворити на "заповідник" олігархів] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926173257/https://24tv.ua/deoligarhizatsiya-navpaki-yak-harkiv-hochut-peretvoriti-novini-harkova_n1649205 |date=26 September 2021 }}. 24tv.ua. 7 June 2021 After winning the [[2020–21 Ukrainian Second League|Second League in June 2021]], it was confirmed that Metal will be renamed to Metalist and the old FC Metalist Kharkiv logo will be returned to the club, along with its brand and history. Following a season in the Ukrainian Premier League, in 2023 the revived Metalist was relegated back to the second tier where it struggled in performance as well as dealing with legal proceedings to claim back the Metalist heritage by paying off old debts.[https://sport.ua/news/651208-mogut-prekratit-sushchestvovanie-u-metallista-problemy-s-dolgami Может прекратить существование? У Металлиста проблемы с долгами] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231109144243/https://sport.ua/news/651208-mogut-prekratit-sushchestvovanie-u-metallista-problemy-s-dolgami |date=9 November 2023 }}. sport.ua. 9 November 2023"}}
